knowledge:
- key_parameters: exons=A list of GRanges objects containing start and end coordinates of exons for each transcript ;; cdss=An optional list of GRanges objects containing start and end coordinates of coding sequences ;; annotations=An optional data frame with transcript_id, gene_name, and strand columns ;; track_data=A data frame containing sample metadata, including sample_id, scaling_factor, bigWig (path to BigWig files), track_id, and colour_group ;; rescale_introns=Logical; if TRUE, rescales introns to a fixed length (default 50 bp) to focus on exons ;; mean_only=Logical; if TRUE, plots the mean coverage per group; if FALSE, overlays individual samples ;; coverage_ranges_pq=Optional path to a Parquet file containing coverage data to reduce I/O demands ;; coverage_type=Character; set to "line" to overlay multiple conditions on a single track ;; connect_exons=Logical; set to FALSE to plot non-transcript genomic annotations (e.g., peaks) ;; transcript_label=Logical; set to FALSE to hide transcript labels
- alternatives: coverage_ranges_pq=Use Parquet files instead of BigWig files to substantially reduce I/O demands when working with a large number of samples ;; plotTranscriptsFromEnsembldb/plotCoverageFromEnsembldb=Use when you want to extract annotations automatically from an Ensembl database (EnsDb) ;; plotTranscriptsFromUCSC/plotCoverageFromUCSC=Use when you want to extract annotations automatically from a UCSC database (TxDb)
- when_to_use: Use when you need to visualize RNA-seq, ATAC-seq, ChIP-seq, or DNase-seq read coverage across exons or genomic regions, especially when genes have long introns that make exons hard to see on a standard genomic scale.
- pitfalls: Legends cannot be automatically added to read coverage plots because wiggleplotr uses cowplot::plot_grid to align the coverage and annotation plots, which does not support legends.

workflows.name: transcript_annotation_plotting
workflows.intent: Plot transcript structures (exons, introns, and coding sequences) from manual GRanges or database objects.
input: metadata_df (data frame of transcript metadata, optional)
workflows.stages: 1. Load transcript annotations (exons, CDS, and metadata) or database objects ;; 2. Plot transcript structures using plotTranscripts, plotTranscriptsFromEnsembldb, or plotTranscriptsFromUCSC, optionally setting rescale_introns = TRUE to shorten introns.
workflows.code:
plotTranscripts(ncoa7_exons, ncoa7_cdss, ncoa7_metadata, rescale_introns = FALSE)
plotTranscripts(ncoa7_exons, ncoa7_cdss, ncoa7_metadata, rescale_introns = TRUE)
plotTranscripts(ncoa7_exons, rescale_introns = TRUE)
library("ensembldb")
library("EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86")
plotTranscriptsFromEnsembldb(EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86, gene_names = "NCOA7", 
                             transcript_ids = c("ENST00000438495", "ENST00000392477"))
require("org.Hs.eg.db")
require("TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38.knownGene")
plotTranscriptsFromUCSC(orgdb = org.Hs.eg.db, txdb = TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38.knownGene, 
                        gene_names = "NCOA7", transcript_ids = c("ENST00000438495.6", "ENST00000368357.7"))

workflows.name: read_coverage_plotting
workflows.intent: Plot sequencing read coverage from BigWig or Parquet files across transcript structures.
input: bigwig_files (BigWig files containing read coverage) or parquet_file (Parquet file containing coverage ranges)
sample_metadata (data frame containing sample IDs and conditions)
workflows.stages: 1. Create a sample metadata data frame containing sample IDs, conditions, scaling factors, and paths to BigWig files ;; 2. Add track_id and colour_group columns to define plotting tracks and colors ;; 3. Plot read coverage alongside transcript annotations using plotCoverage, optionally specifying Parquet input, overlaying individual samples, or using line plots.
workflows.code:
sample_data = dplyr::tibble(
  sample_id = c("aipt_A", "aipt_C", "bima_A", "bima_C"), 
  condition = factor(c("Naive", "LPS", "Naive", "LPS"), levels = c("Naive", "LPS")), 
  scaling_factor = 1)
sample_data = sample_data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(bigWig = system.file("extdata", paste0(sample_id, ".str2.bw"), 
                                     package = "wiggleplotr"))
track_data = dplyr::mutate(sample_data, track_id = condition, colour_group = condition)
selected_transcripts = c("ENST00000438495", "ENST00000392477") #Plot only two transcripts of the gens
plotCoverage(ncoa7_exons[selected_transcripts], ncoa7_cdss[selected_transcripts], 
             ncoa7_metadata, track_data,
             heights = c(2,1), fill_palette = getGenotypePalette())
plotCoverage(ncoa7_exons[selected_transcripts], ncoa7_cdss[selected_transcripts], 
             ncoa7_metadata, track_data,
             heights = c(2,1), fill_palette = getGenotypePalette(), mean_only = FALSE, alpha = 0.5)
require("arrow")
parquet_path = system.file("extdata", "example_coverage.parquet", package = "wiggleplotr")
plotCoverage(ncoa7_exons[selected_transcripts], ncoa7_cdss[selected_transcripts], 
             ncoa7_metadata, track_data,
             heights = c(2,1), fill_palette = getGenotypePalette(), 
             coverage_ranges_pq = parquet_path, rescale_introns = T)
track_data = dplyr::mutate(sample_data, track_id = "RNA-seq", colour_group = condition)
plotCoverage(ncoa7_exons[selected_transcripts], ncoa7_cdss[selected_transcripts], 
            ncoa7_metadata, track_data,
             heights = c(2,1), fill_palette = getGenotypePalette(), coverage_type = "line")
